title: Deposits on a billable work order work as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Add Deposit.
  4. Submit a deposit of $50.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • "Add Deposit" is offered.

Step 3:

  • The deposit window opens.

Step 4:

  • The $50.00 deposit is listed on the Finance tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N5: “"Add Deposit" is not shown on internal and no-charge work orders.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Regular work orders, invoicing, payments, discounts, credits and the customer portal behave exactly as they do today.”
